rqs.primary_result: Matched raw native estimates within reported floating-point tolerances across controlled cases, workload realizations, and fresh deployments.
rqs.strongest_evidence_sentence: Fresh deployment is the strongest closure because new payloads are generated: CE-Replay matches native estimates for every fresh query in both workloads.
rqs.required_qualification: Only the supported PostgreSQL 16.14 fragment and matched payload realization.

rqs.primary_result: Maintenance-feasible mixed designs reach audited neighborhood-local optima and avoid harmful all-statistics behavior.
rqs.strongest_evidence_sentence: CE-Replay drives maintenance-constrained mixed statistics design without a learned design-to-q-error response model.
rqs.required_qualification: Workload-scale results are neighborhood-local; DMV raw loss is dominated by zero-truth queries.

rqs.primary_result: Incremental evaluation preserves audited move values/trajectories while reducing semantic work, but not always runtime.
supporting_experiments: DMV terminal audit and restricted exact recoveries
rqs.strongest_evidence_sentence: Topology controls the opportunity, and semantic-work reduction does not guarantee wall-clock improvement.
rqs.required_qualification: Exactness is within the supported setting; the mixed evaluator is slower than the oracle baseline.

rqs.primary_result: Directed MCV-to-FD composition is reflected in selected FD use and remains replay-faithful after fresh deployment.
rqs.strongest_evidence_sentence: CE-Replay composes directed MCV and FD semantics and remains faithful after fresh physical deployment on both workloads.
rqs.required_qualification: Fresh payload drift is distinct from semantic error; DMV paired frozen/fresh drift is unavailable due to missing provenance.
